items.title: Mesa Laboratories Announces CEO Transition and Appointment of Siddhartha Kadia as President and CEO
items.summary: LAKEWOOD, Colo., March 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Mesa Laboratories, Inc. (NASDAQ: MLAB) (“Mesa” or “the Company”), a global leader in the design and manufacture of life science tools and critical quality control solutions, today announced that Gary Owens will step down as President and CEO on April 12, 2026, and will enable a smooth leadership transition. “Gary has served as Mesa’s CEO since 2017, leading Mesa through a period of significant growth, expansion into new markets, the maturation of the company’s foundation, and the implementation of The Mesa Way business system,” said John Sullivan, Chair of the Board. “We are grateful for his leadership and wish him continued success.” To lead the Company’s next chapter, the Board of Directors has appointed Dr. Siddhartha Kadia as President and Chief Executive Officer, effective April 13, 2026.
